message.content: I've noticed some mild darkening of the skin over my finger joints and knees. I haven't had fever, night sweats or a cough. I don't remember the other symptoms you listed being mentioned. Five years ago I was in hospital for something on my chest scan, but I was never told it was TB and had no treatment. I haven't taken steroids, and no inherited illnesses run in my family. I don't know about other conditions or medications.
